articles.title: Aryan Khan's rumoured girlfriend Larissa Bonesi says he is intelligent and determined, the Khans are like family to her: 'Shah Rukh Khan is the King, will be number one forever'
articles.summary: Brazilian model and actress Larissa Bonesi has described the Khan family as her own, speaking about her bond with actor Shah Rukh Khan and his son,
articles.body: Brazilian model and actress Larissa Bonesi has described the Khan family as her own, speaking about her bond with actor Shah Rukh Khan and his son, filmmaker Aryan Khan. Larissa and Aryan are often spotted together, which lead to the speculation that they are in a relationship. They have not commented on the rumours publicly.Larissa Bonesi, who moved to India 16 years ago and now considers Mumbai home, said her admiration for the Khans comes from both their achievements and who they are as people. She described their support as something that means a great deal to her and said the friendship she shares with the family goes a long way. Talking about her bonding, she told Bombay Times, "The Khans are like family. When you admire people for what they have achieved in life, have respect for them, and how they are as human beings, you kind of feel that they are family. Their support means a lot. Friendship is everything, and it is something that goes a long way.”While talking about Shah Rukh Khan, Larissa Bonesi was all praise. “He is the King. He is a legend, and he is going to be number one forever. There is so much to learn from him. It is not just about being famous or what you have achieved, but also about how you did it. He is someone you look up to,” she said in a conversation with Bombay Times.She was equally specific in her praise for Aryan Khan, who made his directorial debut with the web series The Bastards of Bollywood. “Aryan is a great person. He is intelligent and determined. Sometimes people say, ‘But he has everything.’ However, he does not care about that. He is fighting for what he wants, he is fighting for his future and for the things he believes in. He will get there because he is a very determined guy,” she said. Larissa Bonesi added that she visited the sets of Aryan’s show once and would love to be directed by him someday, saying anyone would want to work with someone that talented.While her friendships have helped her build a life in Mumbai, Larissa Bonesi acknowledged that navigating the Indian entertainment industry as a foreigner has not always been straightforward. She said there have been ups and downs, and that entering the industry from outside the country was difficult at first. Over time, she adapted to her circumstances and found acceptance from both the public and the people around her.On the professional front, Larissa Bonesi said she is looking forward to her upcoming horror film 1920: Cold Winter. She described herself as a fan of the horror genre and said the role was the kind she had been waiting for. She said she has watched the entire 1920 franchise and was genuinely scared by the earlier films, which made the opportunity to be part of the series particularly meaningful to her.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'The Vow' star Jace Cates' dad calls contestant 'rigid' as faith tensions flare in the house
articles.summary: Jace Cates takes Kylee house-hunting in downtown Austin on "Chris Harrison's The Vow," where the pair share their first kiss and open up about faith.
articles.body: WARNING: Spoilers from this week's episode of "The Vow" below. The fourth episode of "Chris Harrison's: The Vow" was packed with content as Jace Cates went on another date and got a visit from his loved ones. In the episode, titled "Mother Knows Best," Cates took Kylee out on their first solo date together, during which they went house-hunting with a real estate agent in downtown Austin. "I think there's some women that I'm really developing strong feelings for, and I'm excited to continue this journey with them," he said. "Today I chose Kylee. She's someone on the first night, we had a really great conversation. She's ambitious, she wants a lot out of her life, and she's so sweet and nice and super cute. I feel like we have a really great connection. I want to see if there's something deeper there." During their date, the two shared their first kiss and got to know each other better. ‘THE VOW’ STAR JACE CATES GETS EMOTIONAL OVER SEAN LOWE’S ADVICE ON FINDING THE ONE "Looking at all these beautiful homes, I wish it wasn't fantasyland," Kylee said. While speaking to Cates, Kylee shared more about her faith and revealed she previously appeared on "The Bachelor." She explained that after her time on that show, she still "believe[s] in environments like this," but noted that she got "burned." "It was never something that I thought I would put myself back in, but I say this like 110%. I'm a firm believer that this was something that God wanted me to do," she said. Back at the house, Haleigh and Audrey confronted Kylee about her faith, recalling a conversation Kylee had with Alexis in which they said she expressed discomfort about how faith-based the show actually is and that she didn't know coming into it that it would be to this extent. "I don't mess around when it comes to faith," Haleigh said in a confessional prior to the confrontation. "It's honestly, it bothers me when someone's gonna put on a show, especially with prayer. That's not something I take lightly. I don't look at her the same. We're gonna confront her about it." They seemed to get to a place of understanding, but Kylee left the conversation emotional, wondering why other people would question her faith. Following the drama in the house, Cates was visited by Chris Harrison, who told him his parents would be visiting and would have an opportunity to meet the women, something Cates was excited about because his parents' opinion is very important to him. When speaking with Harrison, Cates said he thinks his wife is there, but when asked if he wanted to take the step forward and introduce all the women to his parents, he said no. After letting the women know his parents would be visiting, he pulled Julia aside for a chat, letting her know it would be "cruel" for him to introduce her to his parents when he felt his romantic connection with the other women was stronger. "I just couldn't look at my mom and dad in the eye and say, ‘Hey, I could see Julia at the end of this,’" he told the women. "I didn't think it was fair to put her through that. I just want you all to know that you're all here because I do have feelings for each of you and I feel strongly enough that I want you to meet my parents." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE His parents then had one-on-one sit-downs with each of the women, and while they had concerns about some, his dad spoke about the red flags he saw in Audrey, calling her "rigid and combative." "I felt like she was a little more intense. That's just a little bit of a red flag for me," his dad said. "It's OK to be strong, Lord knows your mom is, and I love her for it, but there is a difference between being strong and being a little bit rigid and combative." Cates then let them know that he had noticed some of that behavior himself, noting that when everyone jumped in the pool a few days before, she refused and didn't want to get her hair wet, leading his mom to ask, "So why is she still here?" articles.title: Gérard Depardieu Rape Case Sent To Trial In Criminal Court After Actor Loses Appeal
articles.summary: Gérard Depardieu will stand trial in a criminal court on a rape charge related to accusations by actress Charlotte Arnould, after an appeal by his lawyers fa...
articles.body:
Gérard Depardieu will stand trial in a criminal court on a rape charge related to accusations by actress Charlotte Arnould, after an appeal by his lawyers failed.

The Paris Court of Appeal said on Thursday that Depardieu would be tried for one part of the accusations levelled by Arnould against the actor.

The actress, whose father was an old friend of the actor, accuses Depardieu of raping and sexually assaulting her twice in his Paris mansion in the summer of 2018 after she went to him for acting advice.

The court has ruled that Depardieu will be tried for the first alleged rape on August 7, 2018, but not the second alleged rape on August 13, due to insufficient evidence.

The decision to proceed with the trail comes eight months after Depardieu was found guilty of sexual assault and given an 18-month suspended sentence related to events on the set of Jean Becker's The Green Shutters in 2021.

The acto r last week announced he was abandoning plans to appeal the sentence and issued a statement saying that he recognized his culpability and apologized for the hurt he had caused.

Just days after the letter was published, investigative newsite Mediapart published details of a fresh sexual assault and rape complaint against the actor related to events on the shoot of Guillaume Nicloux's Thalasso in 2018.

His 18-month suspended sentence related to assaults on two female crew members on the set of The Green Shutters .

A number of women, who were not pressing charges, also gave evidence at the trial, including an actress who alleged Depardieu had shoved his hands into her knickers during a photo-call on the set of Netflix show Marseille .

Arnould was the first woman to pursue Depardieu in the courts in relation to sexual assault allegations, but her move came against a backdrop of growing rumors around the actor's sexually inappropriate treatment of female extras and crew members on film sets.

Her complaint was initially dismissed by the courts following a nine-month investigation for lack of evidence, but she filed a second complaint as a civil party, which resulted in an investigating judge being appointed in 2020, and Depardieu being indicted for rape and sexual assault in 2021.

In between times, Depardieu's public star plummeted following an exposé of his alleged sexual misconduct by state broadcaster channel France 2's investigative show Complément d'Enquête , entitled "The fall of the ogre", which aired in December 2023.

The allegations and 2026 guilty verdict have brought his acting career to a grinding halt. Since 2022, he has worked on only three productions, one of them directed by his longtime friend Fanny Ardant.

The criminal court is France's highest level of court reserved for crimes carrying sentences of more than five years, if the accused is found guilty.

articles.title: Before Sai Pallavi's casting as Sita sparked criticism, Shobhna Samarth called the 'OG Sita' by granddaughter Kajol faced backlash for playing the goddess while being eight months pregnant in 'Raambaan'
articles.summary: Long before Sai Pallavi's casting as Sita in Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' sparked discussions, another actress faced severe criticism for playing the
articles.body: Long before Sai Pallavi's casting as Sita in Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' sparked discussions, another actress faced severe criticism for playing the revered character on screen. Shobhna Samarth, whom her granddaughter Kajol has fondly referred to as the 'OG Sita', found herself at the centre of a controversy during the making of the 1948 film 'Raambaan'. The reason was that she was eight months pregnant while portraying the goddess.The issue drew a particularly sharp response from FilmIndia editor Baburao Patel, who objected to Shobhna playing Sita while expecting a child. In his review of the film, Patel argued that her pregnancy was incompatible with the idealised image of the goddess."Her pregnancy stares everyone in the eye and becomes a sickly and sacrilegious spectacle through 14147 feet of the film. It is contrary to the spirit of loftiness and sublimity associated with the name of Sita to ask a woman in her dangerously delicate situation to play a role which is worshipped by millions as the noblest and divine ideal of a woman," he wrote.Patel's criticism also extended to Shobhna's appearance. He questioned whether she was suited to portray Sita, making pointed remarks about her age and physical features."Apart from this problem of pregnancy, Shobhna, as the mother of several children, looks too old and emaciated a woman, with sunken cheeks, bulging anaemic eyes, shapeless arms and sagging hips to portray Sita," he added.The review went beyond criticising the casting, with Patel even urging Hindu audiences to boycott the film. He maintained that showing a visibly pregnant Shobhna as Sita could give young viewers the impression that the goddess was pregnant during her exile.The controversy was especially striking given the actress's earlier success in the role. Shobhna had first portrayed Sita in Vijay Bhatt's 'Bharat Milap' (1942), which depicted the events surrounding Ram, Sita and Lakshman's exile from Ayodhya. Following the film's success, Bhatt reunited the cast for 'Ram Rajya' in 1943, which further cemented Shobhna's association with the character.'Ram Rajya' also holds a notable place in Indian cinema history. Mahatma Gandhi, who was known to have little interest in films, is believed to have watched Vijay Bhatt's film, making it the only movie he saw during his lifetime.However, the same success did not follow with 'Raambaan', which arrived in 1948. The film traced the events leading up to Sita's abduction by Ravana, including Lakshman's encounter with Shurpanakha and Ram and Lakshman's alliance with Hanuman and Sugriva.Despite having earned recognition for her earlier portrayals of Sita, Shobhna's casting in 'Raambaan' became a subject of intense debate, with her pregnancy drawing criticism that went far beyond a discussion of her performance.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Priyanka Chopra pays tribute to the victims and martyrs of the 26/11 Mumbai attacks: 'Remembering the lives lost and the heroes who gave everything on 26/11'
articles.summary: Priyanka Chopra and Bhumi Pednekar have paid emotional tributes to the victims and brave defenders of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks on its anniversary.
articles.body: Priyanka Chopra and Bhumi Pednekar have paid emotional tributes to the victims and brave defenders of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks on its anniversary. While Priyanka shared a short note on Instagram, Bhumi spoke to the media about the strength and unity of the nation.Priyanka Chopra's Instagram tributePriyanka Chopra honoured the lives lost and the security personnel who risked everything to protect citizens. She posted on her Instagram Stories, "Remembering the lives lost and the heroes who gave everything on 26/11."Bhumi Pednekar calls it an attack on IndiaBhumi Pednekar, who was born in Mumbai, described the day in 2008 as "a dark day which halted the city". The 'Dum Laga Ke Haisha' actress thanked those who stood firm during the crisis and said the city holds a special place in her heart.The 'Pati Patni Aur Woh' star said, “I would like to say that all our martyrs, Mumbai police officers, our armed forces, survivors, frontline responders, and all the citizens of Mumbai who have spent such a dark day, and I am also from Mumbai, I was born here, I have Mumbai in my heart. I think the attack on 26/11 was not only on Mumbai, but on our country”.Bhumi also spoke about the spirit of the country and the importance of remembering those affected. She added, “But the most beautiful thing about our country is that wherever we see hatred, we will turn it into love; we will turn it into hope. And even today, where we remember all those martyrs, we remember all those people who lost their lives, their families, I bow my head and say that your stories, what happened to you, will never be forgotten. And we will fill the world with so much love that there will be no place for hatred. There will be no space for terrorism in the world."What happened on November 26, 2008On that day, ten Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists based in Pakistan carried out coordinated strikes across Mumbai. Their targets included the Taj Hotel, the Oberoi, CST, Leopold Cafe and Nariman House, among other places. The siege lasted 60 hours and left 166 people dead and 238 injured.Security forces killed nine of the ten attackers. The lone survivor, Ajmal Kasab, was convicted and hanged in 2012.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: French cinema star Gerard Depardieu to face trial in alleged rape of young actress, lawyer says
articles.summary: Gerard Depardieu will stand trial in the alleged 2018 rape of Charlotte Arnould, who says the French actor assaulted her in his Paris home when she was 22.
articles.body: French actor Gerard Depardieu will stand trial in the alleged 2018 rape of actress Charlotte Arnould, Depardieu's lawyer David-Olivier Kaminski told reporters Thursday. Arnould accused the 77-year-old Depardieu of raping her in 2018 when she was 22 and he was 70. She claims he assaulted her in his Paris home. Depardieu, a veritable star of French cinema, has faced numerous sexual assault claims in recent years. In May 2025, a Paris court found him guilty of sexually assaulting two women on a film set and ordered that he be added to France's national sex offender registry. CATE BLANCHETT MOURNS HOW #METOO GOT 'KILLED VERY QUICKLY,' STILL 'SYSTEMIC LAYER OF ABUSE' Depardieu initially appealed the ruling, but dropped his appeal in mid-November. "I have come to understand that I belonged to a world that no longer exists," he said, adding, "I have therefore decided to withdraw my appeal." Depardieu also apologized and said, "On film sets, I have long hidden behind provocation and crude humor. I believed my words and some of my actions had no consequences. But they did, particularly coming from someone who held as much power as I once did." Despite appearing to acknowledge his behavior was inappropriate in the 2025 case, Depardieu has denied any wrongdoing in the Arnould case. GERARD DEPARDIEU SPEAKS OUT, MAINTAINS INNOCENCE AFTER BEING CHARGED FOR RAPE AND SEXUAL ASSAULT In a 2023 op-ed in French newspaper Le Figaro, Depardieu wrote, "Never, ever have I abused a woman. To harm a woman would be like kicking my own mother in the stomach." In the essay, he claimed, "A woman came to my house once, walking lightly, going up to my room of her own accord. She now says she was raped there. She returned there a second time. There has never been any coercion, violence, or protest between us." Arnould, in a social media post shortly after the letter became public, called it "a truly vile message." "He positions himself as the victim to elicit compassion and sow doubt. To put things in context, when I went to his place, I was 22 years old, I weighed 37 kilos because I suffered from anorexia, and he was a friend of my father's," she told Elle magazine. The young actress and aspiring dancer also added that "at no point did I consent." Arnould's attorney, Carine Durrieu-Diebolt, also said that she was "shocked and scandalized" at Depardieu's letter. Delphine Meillet, another attorney representing Depardieu, told The Associated Press that he disputes the ruling to proceed with his case, though he did not specify if he plans to appeal. Attorneys for Depardieu and Arnould did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for further comment. articles.title: Jack Nicholson’s son Ray admits he and his reclusive dad ‘can’t talk about a lot’
articles.summary: Ray Nicholson says the Los Angeles Lakers are one bond he shares with his reclusive dad Jack Nicholson, calling sports their "language of love"
articles.body: Jack Nicholson’s son Ray admitted recently that he and his famous dad can’t talk about much. "I love sports so much. It’s also the language of love that me and Dad share," Ray Nicholson told his sister Lorraine in a recent interview for Interview Magazine. "We can’t talk about a lot, but we can talk about the f------ Lakers until kingdom come." The 34-year-old "Mosquito Bowl" actor said he thought that he was going to play college football, but after he lost a game in his senior year of high school and then got a staph infection that turned into MRSA, he had a change of heart. JACK NICHOLSON'S DAUGHTER CALLS OUT HOLLYWOOD'S STATUS-CHASING ELITE IN SCATHING NEW ESSAY ABOUT MODERN LA "And it was this voice-of-God moment that was like, ‘You don’t want to do this. You want to be an actor,’" he said. "I was really scared to tell Dad. But I went to USC and learned to love everything about filmmaking." He said his education there taught him that "Dad isn’t God. He’s not the only thing in this film industry. He’s a beautiful part of it, but a very small part. Yes, of course, making Dad proud is high on my list, but this is really a way of finding who I am. And I feel that I’m on the right path to that." MICHAEL DOUGLAS SAYS KIRK DOUGLAS GAVE HIM $10,000 AT 21 AND TOLD HIM HE WAS ON HIS OWN Jack Nicholson met his agent after he joined the Air National Guard in the 1950s, Ray told People magazine recently. The 89-year-old actor made his film debut in 1958’s "The Cry Baby Killer" while still in the National Guard. TOM CRUISE PUNCHED JACK NICHOLSON AFTER 'A FEW GOOD MEN' COURTROOM SCENE, CO-STAR SAYS Ray Nicholson told Men’s Health earlier this month, "My dad’s my hero. I think he’s magic. I love him more than anything." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE The "Smile 2" actor continued, "When I was first doing a Meisner exercise, and you’re knocking, coming through the door, I was comparing myself to, ‘Is that worthy of three Oscars and a 50-year career?’ So much of my practice has just been learning to be present. And so now I have less moments when I’m in my car driving, crying, thinking about ‘I’m getting an Oscar, and my dad...’ And that’s a good thing. I’ve just gotten way more present about it." MICHAEL DOUGLAS SAYS GLENN CLOSE 'SHOULD HAVE WON' THE OSCAR OVER CHER FOR 'FATAL ATTRACTION' Jack Nicholson won Academy Awards in 1976 for "One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest," in 1984 for "Terms of Endearment," and in 1998 for "As Good as it Gets." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Ray said he loves acting, but he’s also open to the idea that he could do something else with his life. SYLVESTER STALLONE SCOFFS AT NEPOTISM CRITICS OVER DAUGHTER'S 'TULSA KING' ROLE: 'YOU IDIOT' "But the key is being of service, and I believe that ultimately, I’m in the service industry," Nicholson said. "When I think about my dad, he makes me smile every time I see him on screen. I want some kid somewhere to smile every time he sees me." "For some reason, I really f------ love that movie. I think it’s because he loves it so much and he’s like, ‘It’s underappreciated.’ So I’m like, ‘But I love it, Dad!’ I love watching his movies. It’s a cool thing, and I want my kid to watch my movies someday." Michael Douglas gave an update on the reclusive actor last month, saying that he wished he could have worked with him. "He’s not working anymore. He’s well. He has disappeared. I know that," Douglas said. "I still see him, but he is fine. He is up there by his house and walking around in his slippers. It happens. articles.title: Veruschka, supermodel in 'Casino Royale' and 'Blow-Up,' dead at 87
articles.summary: Supermodel Veruschka, famed for Vogue covers and roles in "Blow-Up" and "Casino Royale," has died at 87 in Berlin, her family confirmed to Bild.
articles.body: Veruschka, the striking German supermodel who rose to fame in the 1960s and '70s with roles in "Casino Royale" and "Blow-Up," has died. She was 87. A family member confirmed her death to the German newspaper Bild, noting she died at home surrounded by family and friends. TIM CURRY, 'THE ROCKY HORROR PICTURE SHOW' ACTOR, DEAD AT 80 On Instagram, her former partner and photographer, Franco Rubartelli, paid tribute to her legacy, writing that "she wasn’t just a great model. She was an elegant woman, sensitive, brave, with a beauty that did not stay in the camera, it would get into the soul of whoever watched her." "She had a way of being in the world that you don’t learn; you take in. People like Veruschka don’t go away at all. They stay in a picture, in a perfume, in a song, in a way of smiling," he added. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Throughout her career, Veruschka graced the covers of Vogue and top international magazines throughout the ’60s and ’70s, becoming a muse for designers such as Karl Lagerfeld, Yves Saint Laurent and Valentino. Decades later, she made a brief cameo as a high-stakes poker player in the 2006 James Bond blockbuster "Casino Royale."

articles.title: Jennifer Lawrence ranks Chris Pratt as her ‘worst’ on-screen kiss
articles.summary: Playing "Plead the Fifth" with Andy Cohen, Jennifer Lawrence ranked Bradley Cooper, Timothée Chalamet and more — and placed her "Passengers" costar last.
articles.body: Jennifer Lawrence admitted recently that Chris Pratt was her worst on-screen kiss. The 36-year-old made the admission about her "Passengers" costar while playing Andy Cohen’s "Plead the Fifth" game on "Watch What Happens Live" last week. Cohen asked Lawrence to rank her on-screen kisses with Liam Hemsworth, Bradley Cooper, Josh Hutcherson, Chris Pratt and Timothée Chalamet. ROB LOWE GETS CANDID ABOUT HIS BEST ON-SCREEN KISS AS OTHER MAJOR STARS DISH ON THEIR WORST "I mean, they were all so amazing," she joked, unconvincingly, with her "Hunger Games" costar Hutcherson sitting next to her. "OK, I’ll go: Pratt, Chalamet, who’s the other one?" she asked. DAX SHEPARD ADMITS TO HITTING ON AN A-LIST ACTRESS WHILE SHE WAS STILL MARRIED "Best to worst," Cohen repeated. "Oh, best to worst," she answered. "Best is Josh, and then, OK, Hemsworth, Cooper, Chalamet, Pratt." articles.title: 'One Job Away' campaign is helping SAG-AFTRA members meet work thresholds to keep health insurance
articles.summary: Actor Cheyenne Jackson’s “One Job Away" campaign helping fellow SAG-AFTRA members meet work thresholds to maintain health insurance
articles.body: A grassroots social media campaign led by actor and singer Cheyenne Jackson has helped fellow SAG-AFTRA members struggling during declining film and TV production earn enough to keep their union health insurance. Jackson, known for his roles in "American Horror Story," "30 Rock" and "Glee," launched the "One Job Away" movement on Instagram last month to spotlight fellow performers struggling to earn enough to maintain medical coverage through the Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists. SAG-AFTRA requires members to earn at least $28,000 annually to qualify for health insurance, with four quarterly deadlines for meeting that threshold, depending on when they joined the union. NEWSOM SAYS FILM TAX INCENTIVES ARE BRINGING HOLLYWOOD HOME BUT INDUSTRY EXPERTS WARN IT MAY BE 'TOO LATE' For actors working job to job, meeting that requirement has become increasingly difficult as U.S. film and TV production contracts and healthcare costs rise. "So the success of the project so far at last count is that eight actors have been hired directly and at least 12 to 15 have been pinned or called back or gotten really close," Jackson told Fox News Digital. He described an overwhelming response, including hundreds of direct messages from actors hoping to be featured, many of whom are just a few hundred dollars short of qualifying. Among them is William Ngo, who was born and raised in Southern California but relocated to Philadelphia after work dried up following the pandemic and the 2023 SAG-AFTRA strike. Ngo, whose credits include The CW’s "The Vampire Diaries," HBO Max’s "The Staircase" and Apple’s "Bad Monkey," is just $500 short of qualifying for SAG-AFTRA health insurance. Actress and stunt performer Marie Gibeault, whose credits include Netflix’s "The Four Seasons" and multiple commercials, is only $800 short of qualifying. Navy veteran, actor and voice-over artist Jonathan Medina needs one guest role to qualify by the end of the year. ROB RIGGLE SAYS HOLLYWOOD WORK IS DISAPPEARING FROM LA: 'IT'S THE EXCEPTION NOW' Actor Alejandro Cardenas reached out to thank Jackson after the campaign helped him book a small role that put him over the earnings threshold. "After Cheyenne posted my picture and info, an executive from Lionsgate and friend of mine immediately called me and set me up into this job so I could make the money needed to reach the minimum to qualify for my health insurance again," Cardenas told Fox News Digital from the set he was working on in New Jersey. The actors’ profiles share a common thread: dwindling opportunities in Hollywood during fewer scripted television orders, increased cost-cutting and the continued shift of production elsewhere. TRUMP, SCHIFF FORGE UNLIKELY ALLIANCE AS HOLLYWOOD BLEEDS JOBS Jackson previously described the industry’s struggles as "systemic" during an interview with The Hollywood Reporter. "People that have been leads of television shows have worked for years and years and years, and you know their faces, and you know their work. This year, they’re like, ‘What am I going to do?’" he said. Meanwhile, beginning Jan. 1, quarterly premiums and earnings thresholds are expected to rise by 1%, with additional annual increases of 1% to follow, according to terms negotiated in SAG-AFTRA’s latest contract with streamers and studios. A petition calling for an audit of the union’s health plan has also gained traction among members. SAG-AFTRA, which represents approximately 170,000 media professionals worldwide, has faced criticism over the nearly $1.1 million annual salary of its national executive director and chief negotiator, Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, as members struggle financially. Fox News Digital reached out to SAG-AFTRA’s chief communications and marketing officer, Pamela Greenwalt, for comment. In response, a union representative provided a healthcare fact sheet and a membership termination sheet. Jackson, who also performs onstage, has expressed a desire to discuss how the system works, noting that actors can have a strong earnings year followed by a lean one that leaves them ineligible for health benefits. He told Fox News Digital that launching "One Job Away" was a way to pass along kindness he had received. Last year, for the first time in his 20-year career, Jackson found himself $6,000 short of meeting the health insurance eligibility requirements. Actress Kathy Bates, who had worked with him on "American Horror Story," arranged for him to have four speaking lines on her CBS series "Matlock." The work was enough to qualify him and his family for coverage. "I really did nothing," Jackson said of launching "One Job Away." He added that several peers, including actresses Jamie Lee Curtis and Sarah Paulson, have reached out to ask how they can help. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "Just this helping one person makes this worth it," Jackson added, expressing disbelief at the outpouring of love he has received for trying to help.

articles.title: La petición de Jordi Évole a periodistas como Ana Rosa Quintana, Iker Jiménez o Pablo Motos: "El domingo si os podéis quedar en casa, mejor"
articles.standfirst: El periodista de La Sexta ha hablado en los Premios Ondas con un mensaje para movilizar a los electores al 29N
articles.summary: El periodista de La Sexta ha hablado en los Premios Ondas con un mensaje para movilizar a los electores al 29N
articles.body: La gala de los Premios Ondas volvió a convertirse un año más en un escaparate para la ironía y la mirada crítica sobre el ecosistema mediático español. Entre aplausos y risas del público, Jordi Évole aprovechó el micrófono para lanzar un alegato en clave de humor sobre la relación entre la actualidad política, la televisión y las jornadas electorales, recordando que "El domingo hay unas elecciones y hay que ir a votar. Y yo sé el tipo de gente que se junta en los Ondas". Con ese punto de partida cómplice, el comunicador pidió a los asistentes que miraran más allá de la ceremonia y pensaran en el esfuerzo sostenido de determinados rostros de la comunicación. "Entonces, os quiero pedir que penséis en vuestros compañeros y compañeras que llevan cuatro años dándolo todo para que caiga este Gobierno", señaló, invitando a la sala a poner nombres y apellidos a esa idea. En su enumeración, Évole citó de forma directa a figuras muy reconocidas del panorama mediático y de la tertulia política. "Pensad en ellos, que se os pase por la cabeza, yo qué sé, Iker (Jiménez), Pablo (Motos), Antonio (Ferreras), Carmen (Porter), Ana Rosa (Quintana)... pensad en todos ellos y sobre todo también pensad en Eduardo Inda. Acordaros de él el domingo". El tono satírico alcanzó su punto culminante cuando el presentador vinculó el resultado de las urnas con el estado de ánimo de esos comunicadores al día siguiente. "No les demos un mal lunes. Esta gente lleva mucho tiempo dándolo todo para que esto cambie. No les demos un mal lunes, por favor", añadió ante la reacción de los presentes. Évole cerró su intervención con una frase de aparente recomendación que arrancó una reacción en el auditorio, resumiendo con sorna el espíritu de su mensaje. "El domingo si os podéis quedar en casa, mejor. ¡Venga! ¡Hostia, sí se puede!", remató el periodista para concluir su intervención.

articles.title: French actor Gerard Depardieu to stand trial on  2018 rape charge: Lawyer
articles.summary: French actor Gerard Depardieu has been ordered to stand trial on a charge of raping an actress at his Paris home in 2018, one of his lawyers told The
articles.body: French actor Gerard Depardieu has been ordered to stand trial on a charge of raping an actress at his Paris home in 2018, one of his lawyers told The Associated Press on Thursday, less than two weeks after the cinema star abandoned his appeal of a sexual assault conviction in a separate case.Defense lawyer Delphine Meillet wrote in a message to the AP that the 77-year-old actor would face trial over only one of the two alleged rapes reported by actress Charlotte Arnould.Depardieu, who has denied the rape allegations, had challenged an investigating judge's August 2025 decision to send him to trial.The Paris Court of Appeal upheld that decision Thursday in relation to one of the two alleged rapes."He disputes the decision," Meillet told AP, without specifying whether Depardieu would file a further appeal.Arnould first lodged a complaint in 2018, when she was 22. The case has become one of the most prominent in France's reckoning with sexual violence, as the #MeToo movement has faced resistance in the country, particularly in the arts.A French cinema icon faces a #MeToo reckoningFor half a century, Depardieu was a towering figure in French cinema.With his hulking frame, crooked nose and commanding screen presence, he became one of the country's most recognizable cultural exports, earning an Oscar nomination for "Cyrano de Bergerac" and a Golden Globe for "Green Card."But accusations of sexual misconduct and his subsequent conviction have increasingly overshadowed his cinematic legacy.Earlier this month, Depardieu dropped his appeal against a conviction for sexually assaulting two women on a film set in 2021, accepting an 18-month suspended prison sentence and issuing a public apology."I was found guilty," Depardieu said in a written statement on Nov. 16, adding that he accepted the sentence."I therefore offer my deep and sincere apologies to those who may have suffered," he said.Depardieu was convicted in May 2025 of groping a set decorator and an assistant during the filming of "Les Volets Verts" ("The Green Shutters"). The case was widely seen as a test of the French film industry's response to the #MeToo movement."On film sets, I have long hidden behind provocation and crude humor. I believed my words and some of my actions had no consequences. But they did, particularly coming from someone who held as much power as I once did," Depardieu said in his statement.Accusations against Depardieu sparked a national debateDepardieu's behavior toward women came under renewed scrutiny in December 2023 after a television documentary showed him repeatedly making obscene remarks and gestures during a 2018 trip to North Korea.French President Emmanuel Macron drew criticism from women's rights activists at the time when he defended Depardieu, saying the actor "makes France proud."Macron invoked the presumption of innocence and said he would not participate in a "manhunt."The controversy exposed divisions in France over the #MeToo movement.In 2018, actress Catherine Deneuve and 99 other women signed an open letter defending men's freedom to pursue women and warning against what they saw as the movement's excesses.Born in 1948 into a working-class family in the central French city of Chateauroux, Depardieu overcame a speech impediment to become one of France's most prolific actors.His career spanned hundreds of films, including "The Last Metro," "Jean de Florette" and the popular "Asterix" franchise.His excesses off-screen also made international headlines, notably when he accepted a Russian passport from President Vladimir Putin in 2013 amid a dispute over French taxes.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
